description: Operativos de Defensa Civil is a dataset listed in City of Buenos Aires open data portal (BA Data), an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministerio de Justicia y Seguridad. Información de las intervenciones realizadas por Defensa Civil de la Ciudad con ubicación geográfica. Coverage: Ciudad de Buenos Aires. The portal files it under the publisher Ministerio de Justicia y Seguridad. It offers 52 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-06-24 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-2.5-AR. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-caba-portal.
